ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, points $D$, $E$, $F$ are on sides $AB$, $AC$, $BC$ respectively, and $DE \parallel BC$, $EF \parallel AB$. If $AD = 2BD$, then what is the value of $\frac{CF}{BF}$?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is triangle ABC, A is above, B is at the lower left, and C is at the lower right; D is located on side AB, E is located on side AC, and F is located on side BC. In the figure, line segment DE is a horizontal inner line from D to E, parallel to the base BC; line segment EF goes from E to F, and its direction is parallel to side AB. Reasoning: It is known that AD = 2BD, so AD:BD = 2:1, and further AD:AB = 2:(2+1) = 2:3. Because DE ∥ BC, triangle ADE and triangle ABC are similar, therefore AE:AC = AD:AB = 2:3. Thus EC:AC = 1:3, that is, CE:CA = 1:3. Also because EF ∥ AB, triangle CEF and triangle CBA are similar, therefore CF:CB = CE:CA = 1:3. Thus BF:CB = 1 - 1/3 = 2/3. Hence CF/BF = (1/3)/(2/3) = 1/2.
